description: This class defines a Blazor component for displaying toast notifications in a web application. It handles showing and hiding different types of toast messages (info, success, warning, error) with appropriate styling and icons.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component for showing toast notifications, supporting different levels such as info, success, warning, and error. It manages display state through injected ToastService and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Subscribes to toast show and hide events from the ToastService.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Displays the toast message with appropriate styling based on the level.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Sets CSS classes and heading according to the toast level and message.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from ToastService events to prevent memory leaks.
